t: What Do We Buy Into When We Buy a Home? | The New Yorker
s: March 10, 2025 - Low interest rates, coupled with the feeling that having your own space was a matter of life or death, sent housing prices soaring by about forty per cent; in especially hot markets, owners saw their home values practically double overnight. Popular culture both facilitated and reflected that shift. House-flipping shows like “Flip or Flop,” “Fixer Upper,” and “Windy City Rehab” primed us to see homes not as places to live in but as assets to buy and sell.
